description: This file defines a class named MeshContainer within the UnityStandardAssets.Water namespace. It serves as a container for a Mesh object, storing its vertices and normals, and providing an update method to apply changes.

classes.name: MeshContainer
classes.description: A container class that holds a Mesh and its vertices and normals, with the ability to update the mesh with stored data.

methods.name: MeshContainer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MeshContainer with a given Mesh, copying its vertices and normals.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the Mesh object's vertices and normals from the stored arrays.
